LightningComponentBundle.description: Custom split-shipment checkout screen: shipment-as-parent, per-shipment address / method / requested date, item move + quantity split.

property.name: cartId
property.label: Cart ID
property.description: The active cart record ID. On a checkout page bind {!cartId}; otherwise leave blank and the buyer's in-progress cart is resolved automatically.

property.name: checkoutUrl
property.label: Checkout URL
property.description: Where the 'Confirm and return to checkout' button navigates.
